cards.ex: That joke is as old as the hills; I've heard it a million times.
cards.exUz: Bu hazil juda eski; men uni million marta eshitganman.
cards.uzDef: Juda qadimiy, juda eski narsa yoki odam haqida aytiladi.

cards.ex: I'm growing a little long in the tooth to be staying out all night.
cards.exUz: Men kechasi bilan tashqarida qolish uchun biroz qarib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Keksa bo'lib borish, yoshi o'tganini bildirish.

cards.ex: The details of their wedding have been lost in the mists of time.
cards.exUz: Ularning to'yining tafsilotlari vaqt qa'rida yo'qolgan.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishning uzoq vaqt davomida unut bo'lgan voqealar.

cards.ex: She could barely recall the incident, it happened so quickly.
cards.exUz: U bu voqeani zo'rg'a esladi, u juda tez sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror hodisa, voqeani xotirasida qayta tiklash.

cards.ex: The local cinema offers discounts for senior citizens.
cards.exUz: Mahalliy kinoteatr nafaqaxo'rlarga chegirmalar taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Pensiya yoshidagi yoki undan katta odam.

cards.ex: He doesn't want to end up a doddering old fool, dependent on others.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarga qaram bo'lib, ahmoq chol bo'lishni xohlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Aqldan ozgan, bema'ni qarigan odam.

cards.ex: I meant to call her, but it completely slipped my mind.
cards.exUz: Men unga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi edim, lekin bu butunlay esimdan chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani unutib qo'yish, xotiradan o'chib ketish.

cards.ex: His failing eyesight made it difficult to drive at night.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'rish qobiliyati pasayishi kechasi mashina haydashni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rish qobiliyatining yomonlashuvi, zaiflashuvi.

cards.ex: Poverty is an age-old problem that continues to plague society.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik - jamiyatni azoblaydigan qadimiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan, eski muammo.

cards.ex: I have a dim recollection of meeting him once, years ago.
cards.exUz: Men uni bir marta, bir necha yil oldin uchratganimni xira eslayman.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi esda qolmagan, aniq bo'lmagan xotira.

cards.ex: Turtles are known to be long-lived creatures.
cards.exUz: Toshbaqalar uzoq umr ko'ruvchi jonzotlar sifatida tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida yashaydigan, hayoti uzoq.

cards.ex: If you cast your mind back, you might remember the address.
cards.exUz: Agar o'tmishingizga nazar solsangiz, ehtimol manzilni eslarsiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni eslashga harakat qilish, xotirani ishga solish.

cards.ex: After a brief rest, he got his second wind and finished the race strongly.
cards.exUz: Qisqa tanaffusdan so'ng, u ikkinchi nafasini oldi va poygani muvaffaqiyatli yakunladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilikdan keyin yangi kuch va g'ayrat

cards.ex: They reconnected after many years and rekindled their romance as childhood sweethearts.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'p yillardan keyin qayta bog'lanishdi va bolalik sevgilisi sifatida romantikalarini yangilashdi.
cards.uzDef: Bolaligida sevishgan odam.

cards.ex: My grandfather is very set in his ways and doesn't like trying new things.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom juda odatlariga qattiq rioya qiladi va yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlariga o'rganib qolgan va o'zgartirishni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: Some people think that once you turn 50, you're over the hill, but I disagree.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilarning fikricha, 50 yoshdan oshganingizdan so'ng, siz qarigan bo'lasiz, lekin men bunga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Yoshlik davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan, qarigan.

cards.ex: The museum showcased artifacts from a bygone era.
cards.exUz: Muzey o'tgan davrning artefaktlarini namoyish etdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda bo'lgan va hozirda mavjud bo'lmagan davr.

cards.ex: She hoped to live to a ripe old age, surrounded by her family.
cards.exUz: U oilasi qurshovida keksalikka yetishni umid qildi.
cards.term: live to a ripe old age
cards.uzDef: Uzoq umr ko'rish, keksalikgacha yashash.

cards.ex: She's determined to age with dignity, maintaining her independence and grace.
cards.exUz: U o'z mustaqilligi va nafosatini saqlab, qadr bilan qarishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qarilikni hurmat va o'z qadrini saqlagan holda o'tkazish.

cards.ex: This song is very reminiscent of my teenage years.
cards.exUz: Bu qo'shiq menga o'smirlik yillarimni juda eslatadi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi narsani eslatuvchi, yodga soluvchi.

cards.ex: I have only a hazy memory of that summer vacation.
cards.exUz: Mening yozgi ta'til haqida faqat tumanli xotiram bor.
cards.uzDef: Aniqligi yo'q, yaxshi esda qolmagan xotira.

cards.ex: In his salad days, he traveled the world with nothing but a backpack.
cards.exUz: Yoshlik davrida u faqat xalta bilan dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshlik, tajribasiz va g'ayratli davr.

cards.ex: She has a memory like a steel trap; she remembers everything.
cards.exUz: Uning po'lat kabi xotirasi bor; u hamma narsani eslaydi.
cards.term: a memory like a steel trap
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi, o'tkir xotira.

cards.ex: Their ideas have fossilized; they refuse to consider new approaches.
cards.exUz: Ularning g'oyalari qotib qolgan; ular yangi yondashuvlarni ko'rib chiqishni rad etishadi.
cards.uzDef: Eski odat yoki fikrga qattiq yopishib olmoq, o'zgarmas bo'lib qolmoq.

cards.ex: As she got older, she started growing frail and needed more assistance.
cards.exUz: U qarigan sari zaiflashib bordi va ko'proq yordamga muhtoj edi.
cards.uzDef: Jismonan zaiflashib borish, kuchsizlanish.

cards.ex: He's getting on a bit, but he's still very active.
cards.exUz: U qarib qoldi, lekin u hali ham juda faol.
cards.uzDef: Qarib borish, yoshi o'tganligini bildirish.

cards.ex: I ran into a face from the past at the grocery store.
cards.exUz: Men oziq-ovqat do'konida o'tmishdan bir yuzga duch keldim.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda uchrashgan, lekin uzoq vaqt ko'rinmagan odam.

cards.ex: He's a nice guy, but he's not exactly the sharpest tool in the shed.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yigit, lekin u unchalik aqlli emas.
cards.uzDef: Aqlli emas, unchalik zakovatli emas.

cards.ex: We visited our old childhood haunts on our trip back home.
cards.exUz: Biz uyga qaytishimizda eski bolalik makonlarimizga tashrif buyurdik.
cards.uzDef: Bolalikda tez-tez boriladigan joy.

cards.ex: The sands of time are always shifting; nothing stays the same forever.
cards.exUz: Vaqt qumi har doim o'zgarib turadi; hech narsa abadiy bir xil bo'lib qolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtning o'tishi, o'tkinchi hayot.
